recognize_zh: 高倍血液抹片中只看到兩顆中等大小的淋巴球，細胞質淡藍、邊緣略深藍且貼附周圍紅血球，染色質粗而不見核仁；沒有芽細胞，表示 TAM 在 8 週後已自行緩解，只剩反應性淋巴球。
features: Two medium-sized lymphocytes larger than a small resting lymphocyte
Moderate amount of pale to basophilic cytoplasm with deeper blue staining at the periphery and cytoplasm indented by adjacent red cells
Round to oval nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin and no visible nucleoli
No blasts, cytoplasmic blebs or megakaryoblast-like features
Red cells normocytic and normochromic with occasional mild poikilocytes
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows two medium-sized lymphocytes with moderate amounts of pale cytoplasm showing peripheral basophilia and indentation by adjacent red cells, and round nuclei with coarse chromatin without nucleoli. These features are those of reactive lymphocytes. No blasts are seen in this field, and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with resolution of transient abnormal myelopoiesis at 8 weeks, with only reactive lymphocytes present.

ddx.dx: Persistent TAM or evolving myeloid leukemia of Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Would show blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and basophilic, often blebbed cytoplasm, which are absent here.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm, fine dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, unlike the abundant cytoplasm and clumped chromatin here.
LGLs have abundant pale cytoplasm containing distinct azurophilic granules, which are not seen in these cells.
